episodic_summary: As of 14 August, 2022, Joanna reaches out to Nate, stating that it has been a long time since they last talked. Joanna shares that she has been busy with writing projects, describing the experience as a mix of highs and lows, and mentions that her journal has been her rock. Joanna expresses that writing has become a huge part of her life. Joanna shows a photo of a notebook adorned with a bunch of stickers. Nate responds positively, expressing that it is amazing how certain activities become a part of their lives and encourages Joanna to keep it up, stating that she is inspiring. Nate asks Joanna if writing is her way to find solace and creativity. Joanna confirms that writing has become like an escape for her, allowing her to express her feelings and put all her thoughts down to make something good of it. Joanna describes words as having a magical way of healing and shows a photo of a handwritten letter from a man holding a piece of paper. Nate finds Joanna's perspective really cool and expresses appreciation for how words can turn sadness into something special. Nate asks Joanna if anything cool has happened recently. Joanna shares that last week someone wrote her a letter after reading an online blog post she wrote about a hard moment in her life. Joanna describes how the person's words touched her, stating that they said her story brought them comfort. Joanna expresses that it is awesome to realize her words had power, which reminded her why she loves writing. Nate praises Joanna's work, stating that it must feel surreal and encouraging her to keep it up as she is changing lives. Joanna thanks Nate for his kind words, expressing that knowing her writing can make a difference keeps her going even on tough days. Joanna then asks Nate if anything new has happened since they last talked.
